physics.dynamics: conserved Model B: d_t psi = nabla^2 [delta_F/delta_psi]
physics.integrator: ETD1 Cox-Matthews 2002 unconditionally stable linear part
physics.conservation: total density psi_bar exactly conserved at k=0 (E_0=1, k^2_0=0)

phases.crystal_hexagonal: r<0 sufficient density -> triangular lattice (three wavevectors at 60deg)
phases.stripe_lamellar: r<0 lower density -> single wavevector 1D periodic
phases.liquid: r>0 or extreme low density -> uniform disordered state
